proof_integrity: Global uniqueness is analytic by strict convexity and full KKT inequalities; 908 finite packaged checks corroborate the formulas but are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one anomalously priced link in a complete network, a continuous linear budget, and the sum of all pairwise effective resistances.
Does not solve multiple marked links, nonlinear costs, discrete conductances, or worst-pair resistance.
Novelty is supported by specified primary-source and results comparisons, not guaranteed against unindexed equivalent results.
source_date_integrity: The earliest identified public foundational source is the Ghosh–Boyd–Saberi proceedings paper at the Kyoto meeting of 2006-07-24 through 2006-07-28. The end date is used conservatively as the day by which the proceedings source existed publicly; the original electronic posting day is not asserted.
title: A sharp resistance-optimal deletion threshold and a three-objective price ladder on complete networks
